summary: The MaintCourseDetailsCompetency component manages course-specific competencies for a given course within the HSPnet platform, offering both display and editing functionalities, including modal popups and data validation.
purpose: To enable viewing and management of competencies linked to a course. Users can view existing competencies, open an edit modal, adjust competency levels, and save changes, with access governed by session and editability.

workflows.name: View Competency List
steps: Competencies for the specified CourseID are displayed in gvwCompetency GridView.
Glossary link for competencies is available in header.
Edit All button is shown/hidden based on ScreenIsEditable flag.

workflows.name: Edit Competency Levels
steps: User selects 'Edit All', triggering modal popup (mdlDetails) and making gvwCompetencyEdit visible.
For each competency, user selects a new level from ddLevel dropdown.
Dropdown is dynamically populated with CompetencyLevelList.
System collects new values from grid rows and updates competencies via CourseCompetencies.UpdateCompetencies.
User session is cached and redirected accordingly.

business_rules: Edit All button is hidden when ScreenIsEditable is false (read-only mode).
Competencies can only be edited if the user session is valid and screen is editable.
Glossary link is dynamically generated with session query string.
validations: UserSession must exist; otherwise, competency data fetch is canceled.
Dropdown values for competency levels are bound from CompetencyLevelList; selection is validated per competency.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable determines if editing is enabled.
If UserSession is null, competency operations are canceled.
Competency updates only occur if valid input present and save command triggered.
system_behavior: Modal popup (mdlDetails) appears when editing is initiated.
Competency Edit grid (gvwCompetencyEdit) becomes visible in edit mode.
System redirects after save, with parameters reflecting editability and tab selection.
User session is cached after updates.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, competency operations are canceled.
Any invalid CourseID or missing competencies will block further operations.
content_gaps: No detailed business logic for CourseCompetencies.UpdateCompetencies.
No information on error handling for failed updates.
No explicit description of data source structure for competencies.
